description:
Design the extraction of scenario-to-desktop livedesktop and related validation capabilities into a dedicated emulator scenario.

Use a working name of vrooli-emulator for planning purposes and define:
- API, UI, and CLI boundaries
- backend abstraction expectations
- artifact launch model
- how human validation should consume the service
- what stays in scenario-to-desktop versus what becomes shared emulator responsibility
- a migration path that avoids destabilizing the existing desktop flow
name: emulator-extraction-and-service-plan
title: Plan The Dedicated Emulator Extraction
